scope: Actual later helper process reads the already written local unit. The separate selected unit-set receipt records the earlier write. This is process-lifetime readback, not host restart or crash durability.
clock: Public events contain no timestamps. Original line order is retained.
transformation: Exact selected event fields. Task-owned absolute paths replaced with declared placeholders. No other event is copied. Native callable metadata is corroborated against a scoped private callsite. Protected or unrelated payload contents are not copied or decoded.

nativeCallBinding.corroboration: The actual scoped native custom-tool call invokes tools.exec_command with the exact command parsed from this public command_execution event. Only the callable identity and locator are projected. Its surrounding payload remains private.
